items.title: Eliminating Checkout Abandonment in eCommerce
items.summary: Over the past decade, eCommerce has seen an unprecedented boom. With giants like Amazon and Walmart battling for dominance, and challengers such as Wish and Temu entering the fray, it’s clear that the 2010s and early 2020s have been defined by online retail. But as digital marketplaces expand, so too does the sophistication and scale of fraudulent activity targeting sellers, buyers, and platforms.

items.title: How to deal with fraud beyond account bans and manual review?
items.summary: It starts with a sudden spike in transaction disputes as customers claim they never placed orders through your app. Is this friendly fraud, or something more sinister? Your investigation reveals a disturbing pattern. Dozens of different user accounts are making purchases with the same stolen credit cards, none belonging to the actual account holders. The picture becomes clear: fraudsters have exploited a vulnerability in your checkout system, launching a coordinated attack using compromised payment methods at scale. Your response is immediate but blunt - block suspicious transactions. Unfortunately, legitimate customers get caught in the crossfire, their valid purchases declined along with the fraudulent ones. If this scenario sounds familiar, keep reading.

items.title: How a Credit Card Scanning SDK Can Streamline Your Payment Process and Boost Conversions
items.summary: E-commerce sales are estimated to exceed $6.3 trillion U.S. dollars worldwide, and nearly a third of all transactions use a credit or debit card. As a result, businesses have to provide smooth and secure payment experiences to retain customers and maximize conversions. One way to achieve this is by integrating a credit card scanning SDK or Software Development Kit. This streamlined process reduces friction in the checkout experience, minimizes fraud, leads to happier customers and increases sales.

items.title: What is OCR (Optical Character Recognition) and How Does it Work in Payments?
items.summary: Optical Character Recognition technology has become essential for modern payment systems, automating tasks like scanning credit cards and processing invoices. Here’s how OCR works, its role in payments, and the key benefits it offers to businesses.

items.title: The Importance of KYC Compliance for Businesses
items.summary: As regulatory bodies worldwide tighten their requirements, robust Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance becomes even more significant for businesses. The consequences of failing to implement effective KYC measures include hefty fines and severe reputational damage. This not only protects businesses but also customers.

items.title: Preventing AI-driven Payment Fraud Through Phishing Attacks
items.summary: AI-driven fraud leverages generative AI to develop more sophisticated phishing and payment fraud tactics. This, in turn, creates a cybersecurity nightmare as these attacks are increasingly difficult to detect.

items.title: 4 Distractions to Eliminate from Your Checkout Flow
items.summary: Let’s set the scene: a customer is just seconds away from completing their purchase, credit card in hand, and then—bam—a sudden roadblock. Maybe it’s an extra form field, a pop-up, or a demand to create an account. The result? They abandon their cart, and you lose a sale. This is a preventable mistake. Here are four key distractions that could sabotage your checkout flow—and how to eliminate them.

items.title: What is Account Takeover Fraud?
items.summary: Account takeover fraud has become a growing threat that affects millions of individuals and businesses worldwide. This type of fraud occurs when a malicious actor gains unauthorized access to someone’s online account and uses it for fraudulent purposes. The impact can be devastating, leading to financial losses, identity theft, and a significant breach of trust for both consumers and businesses.

items.title: 4 A/B Tests to Optimize Mobile Checkout for Retailers
items.summary: According to a decade-long study by the Baymard Institute, better checkout design can increase the average conversion rate of large e-commerce sites by 35.26%. Given the potential for such substantial improvements, A/B testing becomes an invaluable tool. It allows retailers to systematically compare different checkout strategies and identify the most effective solutions. ​

items.title: Mobile Shopping Trends and Expectations for the 2024 Holiday Season
items.summary: Last holiday season, ​​retail mobile commerce (m-commerce) sales alone grew 14.5% to reach $125.60 billion, and estimates indicate that over 50% of all e-commerce purchases this year will be made on smartphones. Mobile shoppers expect seamless, secure, and fast mobile experiences, and to capture their attention, brands need to provide an easy-to-use experience tailored for smaller screens, on-the-go shopping, and touch interactions.

items.title: Mobile Payment Fraud Prevention
items.summary: As businesses embrace mobile app transactions, implementing robust fraud prevention strategies is crucial to protect sensitive customer data, prevent financial losses, and maintain trust in the payment ecosystem. In this blog post, we will explore effective fraud prevention strategies for mobile payments, empowering businesses to enhance security and provide a safe experience for their customers.
